value: 炸鸡店双面身份·女牛仔主角
FROM FRIED CHICKEN TO A CRIME EMPIRE

【制作人构图】现实参考图(写实生活化)↔游戏内俯视图(经营卡通)左右对照；核心叙事=炸鸡店是军火交易伪装。
【前景·双面时刻】女牛仔主角(牛仔帽+牛仔背心+红围裙+腰间左轮)占35-45%：一手举金黄炸鸡腿(友好伪装)，一手从柜台下递手枪给战术夹克顾客；柜台下露出现金堆和另一武器枪口。
【中景·店内】红黄FRIED CHICKEN霓虹招牌+玻璃展示柜+钢制炸炉；货架炸鸡盒藏枪管、暗门/后门、角落监控摄像头；金黄鸡腿飞舞(数字22/16)。
【背景·夜城】透过玻璃窗：紫蓝天幕+棕榈树/高楼剪影+霓虹灯牌+警车警灯+黄色路线+红色事件针。
【符号】炸鸡桶(题材记忆)+黄色路线(行为连贯)+红色事件针(犯罪城市感)。
美漫写实(American Comic Realism，类蝙蝠侠阿卡姆/看门狗)+明亮犯罪喜剧+霓虹复古；暖金/橙红前景 vs 冷紫蓝夜晚背景；非Q版非扁平卡通
顶部资源条(粉钻3K/银币200K/金币500K+/齿轮/邮件，黑底白字)；左上角头像+昵称+等级30+战斗力；右上角小地图+城堡图标；左侧ACTIVITY/PASS/STARTER；右侧RANKING/SHOP/OPSS/BAG；底部标题白粗体无衬线全大写，深色底衬占15-20%

为GTS黑帮SLG游戏生成一张Google Play商店首图（1080×1920竖屏），主题："炸鸡店是军火交易的伪装"——经典双面身份时刻。风格：美漫写实（类似《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆》《看门狗》游戏美术）× 明亮犯罪喜剧 × 霓虹黑色城市背景。

[前景·女牛仔主角·双面身份时刻] 柜台后站着一位自信的金发女牛仔主角（宽边牛仔帽、牛仔背心套着红围裙炸鸡店制服、腰间枪套插银色左轮），占画面35-45%。她一手高高举起金黄炸鸡腿作为友好招呼，另一只手却从柜台下偷偷把一把黑色手枪递给一位穿深色战术夹克、戴帽子的顾客；顾客平静地把一个黑色硬壳现金公文箱放到柜台上作为交换。柜台边缘下方隐约可见一叠美元钞票和另一把武器的枪口。这就是"用炸鸡作掩护的隐秘军火交易"的标志性时刻——她灿烂的笑容和热情的姿势与底下那笔交易形成强烈反差。

[中景·店内] 明亮的美国炸鸡店：红黄配色的"FRIED CHICKEN"门头招牌、玻璃展示柜里摆满金黄炸鸡/汉堡/饮料、柜台后锃亮的钢制炸炉。货架上的食品盒下悄悄露出枪管；一个隐藏暗门或半掩的后门暗示秘密通道；角落有小型监控摄像头俯视店内。金黄鸡腿在空中飞舞（悬浮资源数字22、16）。真实材质：砖墙纹理、玻璃反光、钢材、电影级布光。

[背景] 透过店内玻璃窗，黄昏转夜的霓虹城市：紫蓝渐变天空、棕榈树与高楼剪影、远处品红与青色霓虹灯牌、一辆警车红蓝警灯在远处闪烁；一条亮黄色路线蜿蜒穿过街区，一个红色圆形事件针钉在地图上。城市灯光散景营造景深。

[UI] 完整集成手游SLG商店截图UI：顶部资源条（粉钻+3K/银币+200K/金币+500K+/齿轮设置/信封邮件，黑底白字圆角芯片）；左上角圆形玩家头像（紫色描边）+昵称+粉色星星等级30+紫色拳头战斗力数字；右上角俯视城市小地图+城堡据点图标；左侧竖排按钮ACTIVITY/PASS/STARTER（红色通知点）；右侧RANKING/SHOP/OPSS/BAG；底部居中大字标题"FROM FRIED CHICKEN TO A CRIME EMPIRE"，白色粗体无衬线全大写，深色底衬，占底部15-20%。

[风格] 美漫写实：清晰有力的线条、真实比例、精细的阴影与高光、真实材质与布光（《蝙蝠侠阿卡姆》《看门狗》级别）；绝不是Q版萌系、不是扁平卡通。整体情绪是明亮的犯罪喜剧，但带着真实的暗藏危险感——店铺看起来温馨好客，底下那笔交易却明显是犯罪的。

[禁区] 不出现大麻/毒品；反差通过隐秘军火交易传达（柜台下的手枪、现金公文箱）。暴力只暗示、不血腥。不用真实明星脸。不复制GTA/浴血黑帮的Logo、字体、服装。炸鸡店保持温暖诱人，暗藏交易是那个反转。

Create a Google Play store featured image (1080x1920 vertical) for a mafia SLG mobile game called GTS, theme: "fried chicken shop as a front for an arms deal" - the classic dual-identity moment. Style: American comic realism (like Batman: Arkham / Watch Dogs game art) with bright crime-comedy energy and neon-noir city backdrop.

[FOREGROUND - THE COWGIRL HERO, THE DUAL-IDENTITY MOMENT] A confident blonde cowgirl hero (wide-brimmed cowboy hat, denim vest over a red-apron fried chicken shop uniform, a silver revolver holstered on her hip) stands behind the counter, occupying 35-45% of the frame. One hand cheerfully holds up a golden fried chicken leg as a friendly gesture, while her other hand secretly passes a black pistol from under the counter to a customer in a dark tactical jacket and cap. The customer calmly places a black hard-shell cash briefcase on the counter in exchange. Under the counter edge, a stack of dollar bills and the muzzle of another weapon are barely visible. This is the signature "fried chicken as cover for a secret arms deal" moment - her bright smile and welcoming pose contrast with the hidden deal.

[MIDGROUND - THE SHOP INTERIOR] A bright American fried chicken shop: red-and-yellow "FRIED CHICKEN" storefront sign, glass display cases full of golden fried chicken, burgers and drinks, gleaming steel fryers behind the counter. Food boxes on the shelves are subtly hiding gun barrels; a hidden hatch or closed back door suggests a secret route; a small security camera points down from a corner. Golden drumsticks fly in the air with floating resource numbers 22 and 16. Realistic materials: brick texture, glass reflections, steel, cinematic lighting.

[BACKGROUND] Through the shop windows, a dusk-to-neon night city: purple-blue gradient sky, palm tree and skyline silhouettes, distant neon signs in magenta and cyan, a patrol car's red-blue lights far away, a bright yellow route line winding through the blocks, and a red circular event pin marking a spot. City light bokeh adds depth.

[UI] Standard mobile SLG store screenshot UI, fully integrated: top resource bar (pink diamond +3K, silver coin +200K, gold bar +500K+, gear settings, envelope mail, dark-bg white-text rounded chips); top-left circular player avatar with purple border, nickname, pink star level 30, purple fist power number; top-right top-down city minimap with castle base icon; left vertical buttons ACTIVITY / PASS / STARTER with red notification dots; right vertical buttons RANKING / SHOP / OPSS / BAG; bottom-center large title "FROM FRIED CHICKEN TO A CRIME EMPIRE" in white bold sans-serif uppercase on a dark backdrop, bottom 15-20%.

[STYLE] American comic realism: clean confident linework, realistic proportions, detailed shading and highlights, authentic materials and lighting (Batman: Arkham / Watch Dogs quality), NOT cute/chibi, NOT flat cartoon. Mood is bright crime comedy with a real sense of hidden danger - the shop looks welcoming, but the deal underneath is unmistakably criminal.

[RESTRICTIONS] No marijuana or drugs; the contrast is conveyed via the secret arms deal (pistol hidden under the counter, cash briefcase). Keep violence implied, not gory. No realistic celebrity faces. Do not copy GTA/Peaky Blinders logos, fonts, or exact costumes. Keep the shop warm and inviting, with the hidden deal as the twist.
